page_title: ESP 0-1 RSO | Espanyol v Real Sociedad 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Brian Olivan (Espanyol) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Mario Melero Lopez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) commits a rough foul. Mario Melero Lopez stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.
90+2' A cross from a corner kick by Espanyol is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+1' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Now Espanyol have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
89' Javi Puado (Espanyol) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box.
87' Substitution. Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) in, Omar El Hilali out.
87' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pere Milla (Espanyol) replacing Carlos Romero.
86' Here's the change. Sheraldo Becker leaves the pitch and Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
83' It will be a substitution. Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) is ready to enter the pitch as Jofre walks off.
83' Substitution. Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) on for Jose Gragera.
83' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) replaces Hamari Traore.
83' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
82' Alex Remiro displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Javi Puado (Espanyol) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

80' 0 - 1 Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Joan Garcia is just a bystander as the ball flies under the crossbar. The score is 0:1.
79' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' Good defending. Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) tries to find Umar Sadiq inside the box, but the pass is cut out. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
76' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) jumps into a tackle and Mario Melero Lopez signals a foul. Espanyol have a free kick.
74' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
73' Excellent touch by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
71' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
71' Brian Olivan (Espanyol) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
70' Brian Olivan (Espanyol) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

70' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol.
68' Irvin Cardona comes off the pitch to be replaced by Brian Olivan (Espanyol).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikel Oyarzabal leaves the pitch and Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) comes on.
67' Here comes a substitution. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Benat Turrientes.
66' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Brais Mendez will be replaced by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
65' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) tries to find Sheraldo Becker, but he puts too much power on the pass.
64' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
64' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and Espanyol manage to earn a corner.
61' Flag goes up against Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

59' Javi Puado (Espanyol) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
58' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
58' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
57' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
56' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
55' Espanyol concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Real Sociedad have a free kick.
52' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
51' What was Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
51' The attendance for today's match is 20900.
50' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates. Real Sociedad earn a corner.
48' CHANCE! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Sergio Gomez.
46' Rough tackle by Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Espanyol.
46' Referee Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Alex Remiro is alert and denies him with a nice save.

45+3' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
45+2' Espanyol take a short corner kick.
45+2' Alex Kral (Espanyol) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Espanyol will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+1' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Espanyol will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) commits a foul and Mario Melero Lopez immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad in a dangerous position.
40' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) is caught offside!
38' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
35' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' The resulting free kick from Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
34' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Real Sociedad win a free kick.
33' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
32' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul. Espanyol are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
28' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
27' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
27' There's an opportunity for Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

27' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Joan Garcia to dive and make a save. It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.
26' Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle after Jose Gragera (Espanyol) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Real Sociedad have been awarded a free kick.
25' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
25' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is penalised for holding. Mario Melero Lopez signals a set piece. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
21' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails well wide of the left post.
20' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
19' Foul! Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Espanyol win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
18' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
16' Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

14' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mario Melero Lopez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Espanyol are awarded the free kick.
11' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Espanyol.
9' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) sprays a pass out to Mikel Oyarzabal, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
8' Jose Gragera (Espanyol) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mario Melero Lopez saw the whole situation. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick.
5' Javi Puado (Espanyol) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
5' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
4' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Espanyol will take a corner kick.
2' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Espanyol will have the kick-off.
Mario Melero Lopez was nominated as the referee for this game.
